name: St. Mary's ICSE, ISC & International School Mumbai
description:
St. Mary’s School, ICSE is 161 years old. It is a Jesuit Institution and a member of the Catholic Archdiocesan Board of Education affiliated to the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examination, New Delhi. It began in the year 1864.

The International Section was inaugurated at St. Mary’s School, Mumbai, on July 1, 2024, during the 160th year of the foundation of the school.

As the Chief Guest, Fr. Francis Swamy shared his words of wisdom about this new venture in the field of education. His dedication, hard work, and perseverance were key to ensuring the success of this new chapter in the history of the school. Heartfelt gratitude was extended to Mr. Montwyn D’Costa for his support and guidance during the initial stages.

It's clear that the department is dedicated to ensuring every student is well-prepared and confident for their physical fitness tests and maintaining focus during board exam preparation. Keep up the brilliant work!

featured_reviews.review_text: As a Grade 10 parent, I am extremely satisfied with the Social Studies Department at Orchids The International School - PalaGaly. My child's progress has been remarkable! The teachers employ excellent teaching methodologies, focusing on in-depth analysis, historical context, and current affairs relevance rather than just rote learning. The regular interactive discussions, map work, and case studies have helped my child not only grasp difficult topics but also develop a genuine enthusiasm for the subject. It's clear that the department is dedicated to ensuring every student is well-prepared and confident for their board exams. Keep up the brilliant work!

featured_reviews.review_text:
WOW! I'm blown away by the incredible progress my child has made in sports! The rigorous training and practice have been truly transformative, and I've seen a significant improvement in their skills, confidence, and teamwork.

The coaches and trainers have been absolute rockstars, providing personalized attention and guidance to help my child reach new heights. The emphasis on discipline, hard work, and sportsmanship has been fantastic, and I'm grateful to see my child developing these essential life skills.

The sports program has not only improved my child's physical fitness but also boosted their self-esteem and mental toughness. I'm over the moon with their progress and excited to see them continue to shine on the field!

featured_reviews.name: Jaffer Habiya
featured_reviews.review_text: We feel confident our child is safe and supported at Orchids The International School. The staff is responsive to our concerns and needs. Communication between teachers and parents is excellent. We're impressed with the school's transparency and openness. The school encourages our child to explore their interests and passions. Our child has developed confidence and independence at school. The school helps students develop essential life skills.

featured_reviews.name: Satya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Khel Utsav has been a fantastic initiative, providing a wonderful platform for students to showcase their sporting talents! The special focus on sports has not only promoted physical fitness but also instilled values like teamwork, discipline, and perseverance. We're impressed by the enthusiasm and energy of the students and teachers alike. Congratulations on organizing such a successful event – it's truly inspiring to see the spirit of sportsmanship thriving!

featured_reviews.name: Sarita Sawardekar
featured_reviews.review_text: The school’s music program is truly impressive and plays a vital role in shaping children’s creativity. It provides wonderful opportunities for students to explore singing, rhythm, and instrumental skills. The music sessions are interactive and enjoyable, allowing every child to participate with enthusiasm. Teachers encourage students to express themselves confidently through performances and group activities. I have seen my child develop a strong sense of rhythm and appreciation for different kinds of music. The program not only enhances their musical abilities but also boosts their confidence and teamwork. It’s heartwarming to see how music has become an integral part of their overall learning experience. The school truly deserves appreciation for nurturing such artistic talent among the students.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School - Palagaly, I am particularly delighted with the Science Department and its approach to middle school science. The transition from general science to foundational concepts in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is handled exceptionally well. The teachers make learning highly engaging and exploratory, encouraging a genuine sense of curiosity through hands-on experiments and interactive demonstrations in the labs. They don't just teach facts; they focus on the 'why' and 'how,' which is vital for building a strong base. This approach has significantly boosted my child's analytical skills and made complex topics accessible and fun. I truly commend the Science Department for fostering a love for scientific inquiry.

featured_reviews.name: Michael George
featured_reviews.review_text: Although often overlooked because of it's seemingly smaller premises, and lack of fancy fame, or over-the-top college culture and facilities, Dr. Antonio Da Silva is a more than worthy high school and junior college. I spent 2 amazing years at this place for my HSC. The teachers are truly concerned about the students, and the management has no bias or money motives. They provide top-notch quality education along with a bunch of opportunities to shine in extracurricular activities. The campus itself feels untouched by time, it's beautiful architecture and everyone is very polite and friendly, making the environment very comfortable for all. They'll go out of their way to help you. This is a truly underappreciated institution and it has silently being doing its job in giving high class services since many, many years.

featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello everyone
My daughter is studying in orchids international in grade 8

I am impressed with the dedication and commitment shown by Orchids International School towards providing holistic education. The school not only focuses on academic excellence but also nurtures creativity, critical thinking, and overall personality development in students

The school’s emphasis on values and life skills ensures that students are well-prepared for the future. The environment is safe, inclusive, and encouraging — making it a place where children are happy to come every day.

Overall, Orchids International School has exceeded expectations in building a strong foundation for students both academically and personally. I sincerely thank the management, teachers, and staff for their hard work and dedication.

featured_reviews.name: Million Bags
featured_reviews.review_text: This school is a remarkable place where every student is encouraged to excel and grow. featured_reviews.name: Nabila Sid
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely impressed with the quality of education and holistic development offered at this school. The teachers are not only knowledgeable and well-trained, but also genuinely care about each student’s progress and well-being. The curriculum strikes a perfect balance between academics and extracurricular activities, ensuring that children grow into confident, well-rounded individuals. The school infrastructure is modern and safe, and the management is transparent, approachable, and responsive. The leaders and faculty is very good and cooperative.Every little things are resolved in no time.
My child looks forward to going to school every day, which is the best reflection of a nurturing and engaging learning environment. I highly recommend this school to any parent looking for academic excellence combined with personal growth.

featured_reviews.name: Million bags Manufacturering
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a Grade 9 parent, I'm very satisfied with the Social Studies (SST) Department at Orchids International School, PalaGaly.
The department goes beyond rote memorization, making history, civics, and geography relevant and engaging. The teachers employ excellent teaching methods that encourage critical analysis and an understanding of current global affairs. This approach is crucial for high school students. We appreciate how they link the Grade 9 curriculum to real-world context, significantly boosting my child's perspective and analytical thinking skills. The SST department provides a truly enriching and essential academic experience.

Passed from 1997 batch. Reviews were not a thing then. But dare I see myself a very small person to review any institution like a School

BEST 3 YEARS OF MY SCHOOLING
Sorry Johnson Miss, Kenedy Sir, Irin Miss (bless her soul) we were not well behaved at times (all the times).
The technical aspect has helped me lot in my life & career.
The teaching was amazing, discipline impeccable. My school friends am still in touch with. Can still remember Carvallo Sir who was principal then doing his rounds. The monsoon rain blazing in the corridors. In my time canteen could have been better.
Keep the good work going.

I do respect all the negative opinions on Google reviews, but this is a 125 year old institution you are blaming for your kids lack of success. Reflect upon it.
